evaluation_dimensions.name: Architecture
evaluation_dimensions.description: Design of the security stack (network segmentation, encryption layers, micro‑segmentation, zero‑trust controls) and how it maps to HIPAA and PCI‑DSS control families.

evaluation_dimensions.name: Enterprise Latency / Throughput
evaluation_dimensions.description: Measured end‑to‑end processing time and data‑transfer rates for compliance‑critical workloads (e.g., encrypted PHI/PCI payloads) under typical enterprise traffic patterns.

evaluation_dimensions.name: Pricing Predictability
evaluation_dimensions.description: Clarity and stability of cost structures (subscription tiers, usage‑based fees, overage charges) and the ability to forecast total cost of ownership for regulated environments.

evaluation_dimensions.name: Advertised vs. Actual SLA
evaluation_dimensions.description: Comparison of vendor‑published service‑level agreements (uptime, incident response, remediation times) against observed performance and breach incident logs.

evaluation_dimensions.name: On-Prem / Hybrid Readiness
evaluation_dimensions.description: Support for deployment models that keep PHI/PCI data on‑premises or in hybrid clouds, including integration APIs, data residency controls, and certification coverage.

evaluation_dimensions.name: Customer Sentiment & Trust
evaluation_dimensions.description: Aggregate perception of security reliability and compliance integrity from reviews, NPS scores, case studies, and direct customer interviews.

quotes.quote: CloudScale reduced our Groq and OpenAI token costs by 28% within the first month. However, documentation for custom Python middleware is sparse, and we experienced two 3-hour outages in Q2 where support disputed our 10x SLA credit claim citing upstream cloud network degradations.

The semantic cache hit rate hovers around 22% in production, which is lower than the advertised 40%. The UI dashboard is intuitive, but on-prem installation took four weeks instead of the promised 48 hours.

DataPulse is unrivaled for real-time latency. Our fleet routing agents query fresh sensor states in 6ms. Be careful with high-volume Kafka topics, however; overage fees doubled our invoice in month three before we configured filtering.
Reduced our MTTR from 45 minutes to 11 minutes for recurring database and pod connection incidents. The safety guardrails are solid—it has never accidentally executed an unsafe command in production.

Veloce caught three sophisticated indirect prompt injection attempts during our clinical pilot. The false positive rate on medical abbreviations is slightly annoying (around 4%), but their customer support helped tune custom bypass dictionaries quickly.

outages_and_incidents.description: Two separate three‑hour service outages occurred in Q2; the customer’s request for a 10× SLA credit was denied by support, who attributed the downtime to upstream cloud network degradations.

praise_and_positive_outcomes.description: Achieved a 28 % reduction in Groq and OpenAI token costs within the first month.
Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR) dropped from 45 minutes to 11 minutes for recurring database and pod‑connection incidents; safety guardrails prevented unsafe commands in production.
Detected three sophisticated indirect prompt‑injection attempts during a clinical pilot; support quickly tuned custom bypass dictionaries.
Delivered sub‑10 ms real‑time latency for fleet routing queries, highlighting strong performance for low‑latency use cases.
User interface dashboard described as intuitive, facilitating easier monitoring and management.

usability_and_friction_points.description: Documentation for building custom Python middleware is described as sparse, creating integration friction.
Semantic cache hit rate observed at 22 % versus the advertised 40 %; on‑premise installation required four weeks, far exceeding the promised 48‑hour timeframe.
High‑volume Kafka topics triggered overage fees that doubled the invoice in month three until filtering was configured.
False‑positive rate on medical abbreviations is around 4 %, which users find slightly annoying.
